0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Dallas Mavericks visit the Houston Rockets. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot), Jett Howard (illness), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day, and Lively, Howard and Aldama are game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Mavericks' most recent meeting was a 111-107 loss in Houston on January 31, 2026.
